acceptanceCriteria: A real independent verdict set exists and `corvint docs corpus audit report` produces a measured accuracy with Wilson interval on a real corpus, retained as evidence.
Each of the generator-identity, independence and pooled-accuracy limits is either implemented with a spec requirement and test, or recorded as an explicit accepted limit.
body: Residual of V1-2316 lane PR beamfall/corvint#1503 (DCP-V1-260..268). Generator-method verdicts are detected only as model verdicts on generated claims (no authenticated generator identity); reviewer independence beyond provider/reviewer identity checks is provider-reported; no population-weighted pooled accuracy; no real independent verdict set exists, so accuracy has never been measured on a real corpus.
title: docs corpus audit residuals: authenticated generator identity, verdict independence beyond provider claims, pooled accuracy, first real-corpus measurement
